package.name: franka_gripper_msgs
package.description: Minimal copy of franka_gripper's .action and .msg files, generated as a standalone package WITHOUT the libfranka C++ dependency. Only the Python/C++ message types are produced — no robot control code. Lets ROS clients (e.g. our PrismPublisher quest teleop) talk to a remote franka_gripper action server without needing libfranka locally.
